14z-69o (2 tiles, the child shadow) + 14z-70f (113 tiles, the 214+LP GROUND detonation). The second set was invisible for three sessions because every rig fired 214+MP from 2P start distance, where the bomb REACHES the opponent and what you photograph is the on-contact hit explosion. The ground mushroom needs LP (shortest arc) AND both fighters walked back to their corners \u2014 tests/replays/hui/83d_hui_grenade_ground.rpl. Maintainer-identified.
the child sidekick's shadow renders as a solid rectangle; the 214+P grenade's ground explosion renders as a solid FUCHSIA rectangle (the ping-#7 'fuchsia class')

Span rule (14z-70f, second pass): obj_records_dump reports only a multi-tile sprite's BASE code, so a per-drawn-tile inventory misses the other 35 tiles of a 6x6 sprite \u2014 which is exactly what left the fuchsia block after the first pass. Take instead EVERY tile in the effect's span 0x0A00-0x0C40 that vs2 bank 3 has art for and group C lacks; that is a superset covering any multi-tile layout (a 6x6 sprite reaches at most base+0x55). Source mapping validated: group C bank 4 tile c <- vs2 group B index 0x10000+c.
